disease_details: Anorexia Nervosa, restricting type (AN-RS); Anorexia Nervosa, binge-eating/purging type (AN-BP)
treatment: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors; Antipsychotics; Benzodiazepines
uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.

uncurated_metadata: Study population: 77 females with anorexia nervosa (AN) and 70 age-matched healthy control (HC) females, all Danish Caucasian women.; AN subtypes: restricting (AN-RS, n=56) and binge-eating/purging (AN-BP, n=21).; Recruitment from three specialized centres in Denmark (Odense University Hospital, Aarhus University Hospital, Aalborg University Hospital), 1 Sept 2014 to 31 July 2016.; Exclusion criteria: antibiotic/antifungal treatment within 3 months, acute or chronic somatic disease/infection.; Control exclusion: BMI <18.5 or >25 kg/m2, regular medication except birth control pills, antibiotics within last 3 months.; Mouse experiments used female germ-free Swiss Webster mice for FMT from 3 AN-RS and 3 HC donors (donor ages 20-22 yr, BMI 10.3-22.6 kg/m2).; Mouse recipients: AN-T n=10, HC-T n=10, over 3 independent litters/experiments, subjected to 30% energy-restricted diet for 3 weeks.; Study registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT02217384); approved by Regional Scientific Ethical Committee for Southern Denmark.
